subject: Use of geom_range with non-BEAST confidence intervals (e.g. BactDating)

messages.author: cdd2b8a6c967a200
messages.subject: Use of geom_range with non-BEAST confidence intervals (e.g. BactDating)
parts:
Hi,

Can the geom_range command for plotting 'height_0.95_HPD' info from BEAST be used for confidence intervals from other programs?  I'm using BactDating (https://github.com/xavierdidelot/BactDating), and the tree objects it generates are different from those imported from BEAST. I can plot the tree quite nicely, but am having trouble applying the confidence intervals because they are in a different class. The "resBactDating" class file contains  a matrix labelled "CI" that I can extract and parse out, but I'm not sure how to put it back into the tree in a format geom_range will recognise. I would be grateful for any help, and attach a copy of an example data object.

Many thanks,

Mat
